messages:
Sam (CEO): Quick Friday briefing — highlights, priorities for next week, and a couple policy notes. TL;DR: steady platform growth, incident postmortem published, new data-retention policy goes live Mon (opt-in for dev orgs until Apr 6). See details below.

Rina (VP Product): Product highlights: 1) Streaming API beta is on track; internal dogfood shows 2–3x reduction in perceived latency for small responses. 2) New guided onboarding for embeddings shipped to staging today. 3) Need a decision on the default model routing policy for self-serve accounts by Tues.

Jorge (VP Eng): Engineering update: P95 latency improved ~12% WoW after KV-cache tuning. Autoscaler bug caused last Tue's degraded tail — root cause is an edge case in the burst policy. We've patched the autoscaler and rolled a canary; full rollout starts tonight @eng-oncall. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-autoscaler.

Anya (Head of Security): Security/policy: New data retention defaults (30 days for temporary logs, 365 for customer-owned audit logs) will be enforced in Hosted by Mon. Customers with compliance needs can request longer retention via support. We're also enabling KMS rotation reminders; read more: https://redwood.internal/security/kms-rotation. @Rina please confirm product messaging for staged customers.

Marta (CFO): Financials: Unit cost improvements showing — estimated -8% cost per 1M tokens month-over-month due to better batching & quantization settings. Pipeline: closed a mid-market Dedicated deal (3yr commit) with Clearwave — revenue impact +$2.6M ARR (initial).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout of autoscaler fix started at 2026-03-27T22:14Z. 3/3 canaries healthy, scheduling full rollout.

Rina (VP Product): On the routing policy decision — proposal A (latency-first) vs B (cost-first fallback). If we default to A, we'll need to expose a toggle in Console and an API flag. Pinged @Jorge for estimated engineering effort.

Jorge (VP Eng): Estimated 3 sprint-weeks to add Console toggle + API flag and safe rollout. Can accelerate if we cut scope (API flag only).

Sam (CEO): Asks/priorities for next week: 1) Finalize routing default (product + eng) by Tues. 2) Ops: complete full autoscaler rollout and confirm SLOs recovered. 3) Security: publish short customer-facing note about retention policy + support FAQ. 4) Revenue: ops team to prioritize onboarding Clearwave.

Anya (Head of Security): Will draft customer note today, will share in #docs for review.

Rina (VP Product): I'll schedule a 30m decision sync Mon 10am PT. Agenda: tradeoffs, Console rollout plan, rollback criteria.

Marta (CFO): Congrats team on Clearwave. Finance will share onboarding checklist and billing contacts in DM.

Sam (CEO): Thanks everyone — big week. If anything blocks decision Tues please flag me and @Rina. :rocket:
